Question Choices: Which data set has more variability? A: 5, 5, 5, 5, 5     B: 1, 9, 3, 7, 2
Hints: Look at how much the numbers change.
Solution: Set A has no change -> no variability. Set B has different values -> high variability

Question Choices: Is this a statistical question? "How tall is my teacher?" Answer yes or no
Solution: Only one data point -> no variability -> not statistical

Question Choices: Is this a statistical question? "What is the average shoe size of students in the school?" Answer yes or no
Hints: Do we need multiple data points?
Solution: You must collect many shoe sizes -> data varies -> statistical

Question Choices: Which situation has variability? A: Everyone finished the race in 60 seconds     B: Times are 55, 58, 62, 70, 75
Hints: Look at how much the numbers change.
Solution: A -> all the same -> no variability. B -> different -> variability exists

Question Choices: Is this statistical? "How many pets do students in my grade have?" Answer yes or no
Solution: Different students -> different answers -> variability -> statistical
